text:
cheng: heads up — seeded warmstart panel showing a big drop in token_savings for rw-7b-q4 on /api/chat. looks like hit-rate collapsed for a subset of tenants.

maria: link -> https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/seeded-warmstart?range=24h :eyes:

cheng: baseline hit_rate moved 0.72 -> 0.43 around 03:10 UTC. kernel selector flipped to 'fused_attn_v2' at about that time per deploy logs.

sam: did we push any batching heuristics or keying changes recently? I adjusted batching for short seqs last week but shouldn't affect key derivation.

cheng: deploy logs show kernel selector config change at 03:08, commit c9a4f8 — added edge case for sequence_length=1 (auto-kernel selector).

liam: could be key normalization mismatch — seeded warmstart keys use prompt-seed v2 hashing; did we change template ordering or backcompat? :thinking_face:

maria: pulled the perf profile. KV lookup latency stable, but miss-path token generation cost up ~1.8x. implies fewer cached prefixes are matching, not slower lookups.

cheng: sample query I ran for cache_key counts on the route:
```
SELECT cache_key, count(*)
FROM prefix_cache
WHERE model='rw-7b-q4' AND route='/api/chat' AND ts > now() - interval '4 hours'
GROUP BY cache_key ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20;
```

sam: results look like fragmentation — previously dominant keys replaced by many low-frequency keys. likely templating inserted per-request ids.

liam: we shipped a template change for tenants A/B last night. it rearranged optional slots -> could change tokenization order -> new cache keys.

maria: quick mitigation: add temporary 'seeded-normalizer' fallback that strips variable slot ids before keying. can we hotpatch to canary?

cheng: @ops-bot start rollout? /ops deploy canary seeded-normalizer to dedicated pool

ops-bot: deploy started — canary on 2 nodes (us-west). watching prefix_cache_hitrate, token_savings, p50 latency.

liam: also let's add a dashboard slice that shows token_saved by customer and by kernel selection. right now panels are only per-model/per-route which hides kernel-level effects.

sam: I'll open a GH issue with checklist: reproduce, backfill missed keys for last 6h, normalizer hotpatch, kernel rollback runbook.

cheng: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/1345 :writing_hand: assigning @sam @liam — tagging perf-bot for alerts.

perf-bot: perf alert: token_savings drop >30% for route=/api/chat model=rw-7b-q4 — incident created infra-1345.

maria: tl;dr: root cause looks like template change + kernel selector shift -> cache key fragmentation -> hit-rate regression. actions: hotpatch normalizer, add per-customer & per-kernel token_saved panels, nightly key-sanity check.

cheng: thanks all — monitoring canary now and will post numbers in ~15m :thumbsup:
